messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SLO alert streaming-api.p99 > 2.5s in eu-west for last 5m. p95 elevated. Auto page.

devon_oncall: I'll take this. Quick ask: any immediate customer reports? tagging SRE rotation.

maria_sre: digging into dashboards now. p99 jumped from ~420ms up to 2.7s; p95 from ~180ms to ~820ms. Request rate steady. Spike looks tail-heavy, streaming chunk gap counts high.

nina_platform: telemetry shows prefix-cache hit for namespace `v2_xform` collapsed from ~92% to ~17% starting ~3287651200. Misses line up precisely with p99 rise.

caleb_customer_success: CS has three EU customers reporting multipart streaming pauses/timeouts. They're seeing the stream stall ~2s then resume.

ashley_eng: any recent changes touching key hashing or cache placement? I merged PR #452 (prefix salting) into canary yesterday and promoted to eu-west at ~3287648000.

maria_sre: that aligns. Tracing shows same keys, different hash output after salting — mapping to different cache shards.

maria_sre: trace excerpt:

```
# pre-salt runtime
key = "prefix:abc123:seq"
hash -> 0x7f3a2c

# post-salt runtime
key = "prefix:abc123:seq"
hash -> salted(0x7f3a2c, salt=0x4b) -> 0x2a9f1
```

maria_sre: cache ring uses raw hash for shard placement. Salted hash points to new shards that are cold -> high miss rate -> cache thrash and tail latency.

devon_oncall: root cause likely keyspace shift from the rollout. Mitigation options: immediate rollback of salting, route streaming traffic to bypass cache, or aggressive warm/prefetch of salted keyspace. Thoughts?

nina_platform: warming salted keys is doable but will take time for hot prefixes. Fastest stopgap: set routing header to bypass prefix-cache for streaming requests in eu-west and rollback the salting rollout there. Also kick off a targeted prefetch for salted namespace to speed recovery in other regions.

ops_incident_bot: runbook hint: if p99>2s and cache-hit<30% then rollback cache-affecting deploy + enable bypass. https://redwood/internal/runbooks/cache-keyspace-shift

ashley_eng: I can perform eu-west rollback: `kubectl -n infra rollout undo deployment/prefix-salt-lib --to-revision=5`. Also can flip a helm value to route streaming.eu-west.cacheBypass=true.

maria_sre: do eu-west rollback first, enable bypass header `x-cache-bypass: 1` for streaming-api in eu-west while rollback propagates.

caleb_customer_success: I'll prepare a customer advisory. Please confirm when rollback starts so I can share ETA.

devon_oncall: ashley, proceed. maria, set the routing bypass. I'll monitor metrics and coordinate pages.

ashley_eng: executing now:

```
kubectl -n infra rollout undo deployment/prefix-salt-lib --to-revision=5
helm upgrade redwood-routing --set streaming.eu-west.cacheBypass=true --namespace infra
```

ashley_eng: rollback started; watching pods.

maria_sre: routing rule applied. Requests now take cache-bypass path. p99 already trending down from 2.7s to ~1.1s; chunk gap rate dropping.

incident-bot: alert suppression enabled for this thread for 10m while mitigation in progress.

nina_platform: I launched a prefetch job warm-328765 to populate salted keyspace for unaffected regions; ETA ~30m for large namespace.

maria_sre: rollback in eu-west completed at ~3287653300; pods healthy and probes passing.

devon_oncall: monitoring: current p99 ~870ms, p95 ~280ms, trending down. Streaming chunk gaps down ~78% vs peak.

ashley_eng: follow-up plan: revert salting change in source, add explicit cache migration/warm step before any re-rollout, add a feature-flag gating for salting behind pre-warm.

caleb_customer_success: message to customers drafted: "We identified a cache keying change in a recent rollout that temporarily increased streaming latencies. We rolled back the change in EU and enabled a temporary cache bypass; recovery is in progress and we expect full service restoration within 30 minutes." Will send once rollback confirmed.

devon_oncall: current state: mitigated in eu-west, prefetch running globally, p99 trending toward baseline. Handoff notes for night on-call:
- watch prefetch job warm-328765 progress and completion
- verify no other regions have partial promotion of PR #452 (scan canary tags)
- block repromotion of PR #452 until migration + pre-warm strategy documented
- prepare incident timeline + postmortem

maria_sre: adding bullet points to incident doc: root cause = prefix keyspace shift due to salting; impact = p99 spike + 3 customers affected with partial timeouts; mitigation = rollback, routing bypass, prefetch; next steps = revert code + staged reintroduce with migration.

devon_oncall: handoff to night: owners -> @maria_sre (monitoring), @ashley_eng (code revert & migration), @caleb_customer_success (customer comms). Paging night rotation @sre-night.

sre-night: acknowledged, will pick up at 00:30 UTC. please paste prefetch job link and final metrics before handoff.

devon_oncall: final metrics pre-handoff: p99 peak 2.72s -> now 0.86s; `v2_xform` cache-hit restored to ~88% in eu-west after rollback + warm; 3 customers experienced degraded streaming; paging closed. Attaching timeline to postmortem doc.

ops_incident_bot: severity downgraded to P2. Live dash: https://dashboards/internal/streams?incident=3287654321

maria_sre: note for future: never promote cache-affecting keying changes without an explicit warm/migration plan and cross-region checklists.

devon_oncall: thanks all. handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
